flawed_step: 0024 | The claim that proving χ(∂G)=3 suffices, together with χ(Ḡ)=3, to prove G is 3-colourable is unjustified. Separate 3-colourings of the subgraphs need not agree on their shared/incident structure and therefore need not combine into a 3-colouring of G.
assessment_summary: The proof fails at step 0024: 3-colourability of the interior arrangement and boundary does not imply that their colourings are compatible. The opening update explicitly acknowledges this gap.
